User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the EduVerse platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

registrationDate.description: Date and time the user registered.

BlogPost.title: BlogPost
BlogPost.description: Represents a blog post on the IDL platform.

StudyPlan.title: StudyPlan
StudyPlan.description: Represents a personalized study plan generated for a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StudyPlan entity.

startDate.description: Start date of the study plan.

endDate.description: End date of the study plan.

Content.title: Content
Content.description: Represents learning content available on the EduVerse platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Content entity.

contentType.description: Type of content (e.g., video, text, practice test).

board.description: Curriculum board this content belongs to (e.g., CBSE, NIOS).

classLevel.description: Class level this content is suitable for (4-12).

examType.description: Type of exam this content prepares for (e.g., SSC, RRB, Delhi Police).

Progress.title: Progress
Progress.description: Represents user progress on specific content.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Progress entity.
